blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Javier Toledo has been officially crowned Overall Champion of the 2026 Manila Sports Car Club (MSCC) Miata Spec Series, taking the title in car #97. The title caps a comeback that began in 2022, when Toledo, the son of Atty. Mike Toledo, returned to racing after a long time away from the sport. He came back with a single goal — to do it better than he ever had before.
